undo_record_state_consistent.name: undo_record_state_consistent

usage_ledger_cache_tokens_safe.name: usage_ledger_cache_tokens_safe
usage_ledger_cache_tokens_safe.value: "usage_ledger"."cache_read_tokens" IS NULL OR ("usage_ledger"."cache_read_tokens" >= 0 AND "usage_ledger"."cache_read_tokens" <= 9007199254740991 AND ("usage_ledger"."input_tokens" IS NULL OR "usage_ledger"."cache_read_tokens" <= "usage_ledger"."input_tokens"))

usage_ledger_state_consistent.name: usage_ledger_state_consistent
usage_ledger_state_consistent.value: ("usage_ledger"."status" = 'reserved' AND "usage_ledger"."actual_nano" IS NULL AND "usage_ledger"."settlement_fingerprint" IS NULL) OR ("usage_ledger"."status" = 'settled' AND "usage_ledger"."actual_nano" IS NOT NULL AND "usage_ledger"."settlement_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL AND "usage_ledger"."input_tokens" IS NOT NULL AND "usage_ledger"."cache_read_tokens" IS NOT NULL AND "usage_ledger"."output_tokens" IS NOT NULL) OR ("usage_ledger"."status" = 'unknown' AND "usage_ledger"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL) OR ("usage_ledger"."status" = 'not_sent' AND ("usage_ledger"."actual_nano" IS NULL OR "usage_ledger"."actual_nano" = 0))
